Use Plus Jakarta Sans for section headings and Inter for body copy across all sections.
Honor hero headline sizing at 54px and keep line lengths controlled.

Do not add unsupported sections such as pricing, testimonials, or form.

Use media-rich composition to create a premium 3D-feel without overcrowding the layout.

heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for premium visual content creation, multimodal editing, and synchronized video generation.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a premium creative-studio hero on a white base with a warm brand-colored mesh glow and layered media cards rather than a standard side-by-side split. Place the headline on the left with a short benefit stack and strong accent CTA, while the right side becomes a dimensional collage of image-generation mockups and a video preview card. Keep the overall feel airy and editorial, but add subtle depth through shadows, floating chips, and soft abstract shapes. The composition should immediately signal both image and video capability without relying on a centered layout or a plain product screenshot.

repetitionBreakers: Shift from split hero to logo-first proof band
Use an interactive preview-led product block for Seedream, then a darker motion-forward contrast panel for Seedance
Break feature rhythm with a spotlight-plus-grid rather than repeating the hero composition
Move from visual-heavy sections into more utility-driven pricing and a testimonial grid
End with a centered, high-friction-reduction form card on a calm light surface
blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance | AI Image and Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Create premium AI images and videos with ByteDance's Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Explore how it works, trusted logos, product features, pricing, and a fast path to get started.

sections.backgroundTreatment: clean white hero with subtle abstract-shape accents and warm brand highlights; right side shows a layered media cluster of AI image and video outputs with depth
sections.designNote: Make the hero content-first to satisfy warm traffic continuity. Headline must clearly answer what this is: AI image and video generation by ByteDance. Subheadline must answer who it is for: creative teams, marketers, designers, video producers, art directors, and marketing managers. The CTA must be the single allowed button label, 'Get started', styled as a solid full-opacity accent button. Include a compact bullet list under the CTA for text-to-image, text-to-video, and multimodal control to reinforce the ad message quickly. Keep the hero dynamic and premium, with the strongest visual emphasis above the fold.

Place trust immediately after the hero using 3-6 recognisable logos if available; since none are provided, use a clean metrics strip paired with enterprise-ready badges rather than inventing brand names. Keep this section compact and logo-led in spirit, with a crisp horizontal treatment and no motion.

Treat this as the required warm-traffic process section. Present a 3-step flow that takes under 60 seconds: 1) choose image or video mode, 2) enter prompt, upload, or script, 3) generate and refine. Use a split layout with a small preview panel on one side and concise steps on the other. Keep it very scannable and operational, not promotional. This section should feel lighter and more instructional than the hero.

Since no credible customer logo set is provided, convert this into a high-contrast proof band with metrics, capability callouts, and a short trust sentence rather than fake logos. Use a dark charcoal band to create the required visual contrast and to make this the most credibility-dense moment on the page. Keep text tight and authoritative, with warm accent highlights.

Use alternating product blocks because there are multiple product sections and each contains 5+ features, so a flat static grid is not allowed. For Seedream 4.5, use tabs with a preview panel to showcase high-resolution image generation, editing, composition, and typographic rendering. For Seedance 1.5 Pro, shift the energy to a visually richer split panel or cinematic preview block emphasizing synchronized audio-video generation, lip-sync, camera control, and speed. Adjacent product blocks should not repeat the same visual rhythm: one should feel precise and editorial, the other more motion-led and immersive. Do not use a horizontal feature marquee.

Use two product cards with a clear hierarchy rather than a dense table, because the offer is simple and premium. Highlight Seedance 1.5 Pro pricing with stronger emphasis if needed, but keep both cards conversion-oriented and straightforward. CTA buttons must still read 'Get started'. Use warm accent fill, no outline, no gray state. This section should feel practical and purchase-ready.

With 5 testimonials provided, use a grid rather than a carousel for faster scanning and stronger social proof density. Pull out the most relevant three to four quotes from creative, video, and marketing roles. Keep cards clean, whitespace-rich, and easy to read, with emphasis on outcomes like speed, precision, storytelling, and reduced turnaround time.

Finish with a centered floating card that reduces friction and drives the single CTA. Since CTA aggression should stay aligned with warm traffic, keep this final conversion moment strong but not overwhelming. The button must be 'Get started', full-width on mobile, solid accent color, and visually dominant. Use one concise supporting line that reinforces demo or access intent.

Do not use a marquee unless explicitly asked; use a static horizontal logo strip only if there are genuine media or partner logos. Since none are supplied, this section should be omitted or treated as a subtle footer trust row rather than a moving news band.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long, so 56px balances premium presence with readability without overcrowding the hero.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split hero with brand/logo area above or beside a bold headline block; short supporting copy; compact benefit list with icon-led bullets; high-contrast dark banner treatment and minimal decorative complexity.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Top hero band followed by a lead-capture/form block, then stacked content sections with strong separation. Layout favors single-column reading within wide containers, with clear modular blocks and repeated feature groupings.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Functional white form-card / content-card treatment with sharp edges, light borders or subtle shadows, dense content, and minimal glass or ornamental effects. Cards are utility-first rather than promotional.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is prominent in the hero and repeated per product section. CTA style is action-oriented and conversion-focused; secondary CTAs are sparse or absent. Form submission acts as a major conversion endpoint.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer not visible in the reference; no reusable footer pattern inferred.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Logo lockup in hero and icon bullets for feature lists. No large product media, galleries, or embedded demo panels visible. Visual emphasis comes from typography and contrast rather than imagery.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Repeated feature sections with a label/tag, section headline, supporting paragraph, then a list of features. Each section is self-contained and suitable for progressive disclosure. Product modules can be stacked vertically and separated by whitespace or surface contrast.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form panel immediately after hero, visually isolated as a conversion card. Uses multiple hidden inputs and a compact field layout, implying a structured sales-oriented capture flow rather than a lightweight newsletter form.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-motion presentation with no obvious motion system; if motion exists, it is likely limited to basic banner/slider behavior rather than reveal or micro-interaction-heavy animation.
designNotes: Use strong contrast for the hero and reserve lighter surfaces for conversion modules.
Prefer utility-driven layout over decorative storytelling.
Keep feature lists concise and scannable with short titles and supporting one-line descriptions.
Repeat the same section scaffold for multiple products to create consistency.
Place a lead form close to the top to support high-intent B2B conversion.
Avoid heavy visual effects; the system reads as enterprise and performance-oriented.

designStrategy.reasoning: This page is a high-intent product landing page for solution-aware buyers evaluating advanced AI image and video generation. The strongest conversion path is a demo-booking or quote request, so the design should be product-led with repeated action cues. Since the visitor trusts logos most, logo-first proof must be the dominant trust system, with testimonials as secondary reinforcement. A dark, futuristic, premium visual direction fits the ByteDance generative AI positioning, while an immersive hero, video gallery, and subtle 3D depth improve engagement without compromising readability. The layout should stay balanced and modular: strong hero, trust band, feature sections, video gallery, testimonials, pricing, and final CTA.
